title: Conditions Without Si
goal: Express brisk formal conditions and warnings with de + infinitive and conditional gerunds
grammar: implicit-conditionals: de no ser así, de + infinitive, de haber + participle and conditional gerund

items: I can express formal conditions with *de no ser así* and *de* + infinitive.
I can form compact past counterfactuals with *de haber* + past participle.
I can use conditional gerunds and vocabulary like *la urgencia*, *la penalización*, *el recargo*, *de sobra* and *remediar*.
